verse.verse_7: Surely, what you are promised will occur.
verse.verse_8: Then when the stars lose their lights.
verse.verse_10: And when the mountains are blown away.
verse.verse_11: And when the Messengers are Uqqitat.
verse.verse_12: For what Day are these signs postponed
verse.verse_13: For the Day of Sorting Out (the men of Paradise from the men destined for Hell).
verse.verse_14: And what will explain to you what is the Day of Sorting Out
verse.verse_15: Woe that Day to the deniers (of the Day of Resurrection)!
verse.verse_16: Did We not destroy the ancients
verse.verse_17: So shall We make later generations to follow them.
verse.verse_18: Thus do We deal with the criminals.
verse.verse_19: Woe that Day to the deniers!
verse.verse_20: Did We not create you from a despised water
verse.verse_21: Then We placed it in a place of safety,
verse.verse_23: So We did measure; and We are the best to measure.
verse.verse_24: Woe that Day to the deniers!
verse.verse_25: Have We not made the earth Kifat (a receptacle)
verse.verse_26: For the living and the dead
verse.verse_27: And have placed therein fixed towers, and have given you Furat water
verse.verse_28: Woe that Day to the deniers!
verse.verse_29: (It will be said to the disbelievers): "Depart you to that which you used to deny!"
verse.verse_30: "Depart you to a shadow in three columns,"
verse.verse_31: "Neither shady nor of any use against the fierce flame of the Fire."
verse.verse_32: Verily, it (Hell) throws sparks (huge) as Al-Qasr,
verse.verse_33: As if they were Sufr camels.
verse.verse_34: Woe that Day to the deniers (of the Day of Resurrection)!
verse.verse_35: That will be a Day when they shall not speak (during some part of it),
verse.verse_36: And they will not be permitted to put forth any excuse.
verse.verse_37: Woe that Day to the deniers (of the Day of Resurrection)!
verse.verse_38: That will be a Day of Decision! We have brought you and the men of old together!
verse.verse_39: So, if you have a plot, use it against Me (Allah)!
verse.verse_40: Woe that Day to the deniers (of the Day of Resurrection)!
verse.verse_41: Verily, those who had Taqwa, shall be amidst shades and springs.
verse.verse_42: And fruits, such as they desire.
verse.verse_43: "Eat and drink comfortably for that which you used to do."
verse.verse_44: Verily, thus We reward the Muhsinin.
verse.verse_45: Woe that Day to the deniers!
verse.verse_46: Eat and enjoy yourselves for a little while. Verily, you are criminals.
verse.verse_47: Woe that Day to the deniers!
verse.verse_48: And when it is said to them: "Bow down yourself!" They bow not down.
verse.verse_49: Woe that Day to the deniers!
verse.verse_50: Then in what statement after this will they believe
